skills.elemental_burst: Coalesces atmospheric frost and snow to summon a Sacred Cryo Pearl that exorcises evil. During its ability duration, the Sacred Cryo Pearl will continuously rain down shards of ice, striking opponents within an AoE and dealing Cryo DMG. This ability will drop up to icicles over its duration, with each icicle targeting a random enemy that has not been targeted by the last icicles. Ice Shard DMG will snapshot Ganyu's stats on cast and will not be affected by changes in her stats that occur afterwards.
